test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_index_count_streams (ts DateTime, host String, message String, INDEX idx_msg message TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha) GRANULARITY 1) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY ts SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO text_index_count_streams SELECT toDateTime(1704000000 + number), concat('host', toString(number % 64)), concat('w', leftPad(toString(cityHash64(number) % 40000), 5, '0'), ' ', 'w', leftPad(toString((number % 32) * 1250), 5, '0'), ' code', toString(200 + number % 5)) FROM numbers(800000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 2000, max_insert_block_size = 2000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
test.query: SELECT count() FROM text_index_count_streams WHERE hasToken(message, 'w01250')
SELECT count() FROM text_index_count_streams WHERE hasAnyTokens(message, ['w01250', 'w02500', 'w03750', 'w05000', 'w06250', 'w07500', 'w08750', 'w10000'])
